name: Dress Attire
overview: Scripture teaches that dress attire reflects a believer's commitment to God's order and holiness. Deuteronomy 22:5 clearly prohibits cross-dressing, emphasizing the importance of maintaining distinctions God established between men and women. Proverbs 7:10 warns against adopting garments associated with immorality, highlighting how attire can reveal one's heart condition. Ultimately, Romans 12:1 and Colossians 3:1 call believers to present their bodies as holy sacrifices and to seek heavenly things, encouraging dress that honors Christ and reflects a transformed life.
